pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions on the upper flank exhibit sharp, serrated edge gradients and high spatial area. Patches on the lower posterior regions are smaller, more circular, and exhibit smoother edge transitions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-pigmented pathways form a continuous graph with frequent tri-point junction nodes. Pathway thickness is narrow and uniform on the upper flank, widening significantly between smaller patches on the lower posterior region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the visible upper neck line shows a consistent, low-amplitude jagged silhouette against the background bokeh.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A large region of dark, rugose textural disruption and hyper-pigmentation is visible along the dorsal ridge and upper shoulder area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, circular, white and pink de-pigmented lesion is present on the posterior flank near the tail base.
other_distinctive_markers: The transitions in patch density from the mid-flank to the posterior create a high-contrast gradient effect in the topological graph.
